title: Restriction-form transition of simultaneous derived direct image
statement:
Let $u:V\to W$ be any morphism of schemes, and use small representatives of their pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any strict tower of sheaves of commutative rings on $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$, put $C_n=u^{-1}B_n$, and use the induced tower on $V_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $\mathscr S(B),\mathscr S(C)$ be the strict semilinear module-system categories, with their ordinary unbounded derived categories and the simultaneous direct image $G=Ru_{*,\bullet}$ of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $G_n=Ru_{*,B_n}$, and for $m\ge n$ write $r^W_{m,n},r^V_{m,n}$ for exact restriction of scalars along $B_m\to B_n,C_m\to C_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $\delta_{m,n}:G_m r^V_{m,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}r^W_{m,n}G_n$ be the inverse of the canonical ring-sheaf-change comparison $d$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. For $N\in D(\mathscr S(C))$, let $a^N_{m,n}:N_m\to r^V_{m,n}N_n$ and $a^{GN}_{m,n}:(GN)_m\to r^W_{m,n}(GN)_n$ be its actual derived restriction-form transitions. Under the canonical natural evaluation isomorphisms $e_nG\cong G_ne_n$, one has
$$a^{GN}_{m,n}=\delta_{m,n,N_n}\circ G_m(a^N_{m,n}).$$
The formula is natural in $N$ and includes $m=n$. Its comparison has this normalization: for a K-injective $C_n$-complex $I$ and a K-injective replacement $r^V_{m,n}I\to H$ over $C_m$, $\delta_{m,n,QI}$ is the inverse of the class of $u_*r^V_{m,n}I=r^W_{m,n}u_*I\to u_*H$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. No flatness of the tower maps, normalization of $N$, or preservation of K-injectives by restriction or evaluation is assumed. Write $T=-\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n$ and $S=-\otimes^L_{C_m}C_n$, with their exact restriction-of-scalars right adjoints [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $b:TG_m\to G_nS$ be the coefficient-extension mate specified in [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For every $M\in D(C_m)$, $L\in D(C_n)$ and $a:M\to r^V_{m,n}L$, the same comparison satisfies the scalar-transpose identity
$$\bigl(\delta_{m,n,L}\circ G_m(a)\bigr)^\sharp=G_n(a^\sharp)\circ b_M.$$
Here sharp denotes precisely the two coefficient extension/restriction adjunction bijections. Thus the scalar mate of the resolution-normalized restriction comparison is the specified system coefficient mate.

source.place: Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition), normalization of the two coefficient factorizations. The restriction-form transition identity is the implicit mate-identification prerequisite using the existing coherent-section theorem.
